purpose: Broadly randomized pretraining data for a world model (deformation-focused). Not a calibration of the experimental chip; not a replacement for the frozen HF/LF science path.
base: configs/frozen/contact_policy.json + configs/frozen/contact_revision.json; only the keys below change, and only in sparse_sequential_step with tier=pretrain
unchanged: hard_geometry_m 1 nm, contact_overlap_m 0.01R, contact_correction_m 0.1R (applied to the actual step displacement), max_sequential_qp 5, force_residual_atol_N, hard-sphere non-penetration and all gate names

tier_rules.osqp_fallback: Only when the active-set QP does not return active_set_solved (observed: active_set_cycle on degenerate contact networks). Same QP; accepted only if every KKT gate passes.
tier_rules.contact_correction: 0.1R limit applies to the largest actual bubble displacement of the step instead of the push cancelled by contacts

adhesion.use: On by default: adhesion_force_N = coefficient x reference^2, reference = the largest single-channel amplitude of the run unless the config gives adhesion_reference_Pa_eq. Randomize the coefficient log-uniformly over coefficient_range_N_per_Pa2 when generating pretraining runs. A config may give an absolute adhesion_force_N instead; 0 turns adhesion off.

apecss_response.use: Optional per run: config "response": "apecss" (default "table", the frozen response tables). APECSS sources from config "apecss_dir" or the APECSS_DIR environment variable; config "apecss_threads" sets only the thread count.

reasons.tolerances: Residual tolerances tied to the observation scale (a camera pixel is about 600 nm) instead of 1e-13 m; the strict tier stalls on degenerate contact networks (evidence: STRICT_VS_PRETRAIN.json).
reasons.stepping: One constrained solve per step; the step grows while the largest actual displacement stays near displacement_over_R x R and halves on any failed gate, never accepting a failed step. Since 2026-11-04: target 0.5% of R (was 3%), max step 2 ms (was 0.5 ms), and a failed step caps the following steps at 0.8x its size, the cap rising 2% per accepted step (rejection memory; never below min_step_s). Reason: formed clusters with adhesion turn rigidly; the rotation rate converges once a step needs a single linearization of the contacts (fixed 0.0625/0.125/0.25 ms agree within 0.01 nm), while the earlier 0.5 ms steps were re-linearized and turned 29% too fast; 0.5% R comes within 7% and 0.22 px (earlier control 0.73 px), at half the time of the earlier control on the protocol run, 3.6x faster on N128 and 4.6x on random actions (evidence/pretrain_step_control_20261104/). The per-step displacement fixes the accuracy at any source level (all forces scale with A^2). Config "step_control": "2026-11-02" reproduces earlier runs bit for bit (stepping_earlier). Earlier comparisons against fixed 1 us and 0.5 us references: NBODY_SUMMARY.json and PAIRWISE_SUMMARY.json.
reasons.source_cap: 6000 Pa-equivalent since 2026-11-04 (was 3000, the largest amplitude of the prototype comparisons), so clusters reach the A/B cluster speeds: one channel at 6000 gives at most 11.7 kPa at the bubbles, four in phase 39.1 kPa, inside the 40 kPa table; 6000 Pa-eq reproduces 3000 Pa-eq four times faster within 0.09 px; protocol and random-action runs at the cap pass (evidence/pretrain_source_cap_20261104/ADMISSION.json). The response-table domain check still fails outside the table. The frozen HF/LF cap stays 1500.
reasons.wall_guard: No wall contact is modelled in this tier; runs stop 2R from the lumen wall or end.
reasons.propagation_delay: Bubble-bubble coupling (collective closure, pair closure and F2) keeps the propagation delay of the radiated monopole field, exp(-i k d) and (1 + i k d) in its gradient, k from the same water model as the field. The instantaneous form is valid only for k d << 1 (wavelength 0.6 mm at 2.5 MHz). Checked against APECSS's own interacting bubbles (fundamental oscillation, linear regime): instantaneous (IC) interactions reproduce the old form, quasi-acoustic (QA) interactions the delayed form within 0.07-0.57% for spread states where the old form is off by 42-109% (evidence/collective_flip_20261103/); the force term against a numerical gradient of the delayed field (tests/test_pretrain.py). Compact clusters change little (k d <= 0.2). A run may set "propagation_delay": false to reproduce runs made before 2026-11-03.
reasons.adhesion: Phenomenological short-range surface adhesion F = adhesion_force_N (1 - h / adhesion_range_m)^2 for surface gaps h < adhesion_range_m (microbubble.forces.adhesion_forces). Since 2026-11-04 on by default through the calibrated coefficient (see adhesion.use); "adhesion_force_N": 0 reproduces earlier runs. Motivated by user observations (clusters stay together after the ultrasound is switched off; real clusters deform about 40x less per pixel moved than collective-coupling clusters); no published bubble-bubble adhesion strength exists for SonoVue, so the force is calibrated against the A/B softness metric. The 0.2 um range is wider than molecular adhesion so the 3% R step control resolves it. Runs with it carry the PHENOMENOLOGICAL_ADHESION label. Calibration (evidence/adhesion_calibration_20261104/, collective coupling with delay, X- held, AG32 started as a round cluster): adhesion_force_N of (3e-11 to 1e-10) x (A / 2000 Pa-eq)^2, A the per-channel source level, stops splitting and brings the shape change per pixel moved to 0.0022-0.0048 (A/B 0.0018; without adhesion about 0.07); clusters still elongate to aspect 1.3-1.5 under a sustained push (A/B 1.12). Started from the registered gapped arrays, clusters lock in elongated (aspect 2-2.3). With the default coefficient the formed initial clusters (inputs/pretrain_formed_states.h5) never split; at 3000 Pa-eq (43 px/s) their shape change per pixel looked like A/B, but that was the pixel floor of the metric. At matched speed (6000 Pa-eq, 172 px/s) they change shape about 3x less than A/B (0.0075 against 0.024 per 0.1 s; rigid floor 0.003), and 0.1-1x the coefficient gives the same: the formed clusters are too rigid for a reason other than adhesion (evidence/softness_matched_speed_20261104/).
reasons.apecss_response: Same APECSS model, case and start from rest as the frozen tables (the 2.4 and 2.6 MHz gates share this case; 2.5 MHz uses it as well); every bubble keeps its own radial state between steps and settles at its own local drive, so the response holds at any pressure and keeps all harmonics. Settling tolerance 1e-3, decay re-measured every 10 calls, ODE tolerance 1e-8 (equal to 1e-10 within 1e-9). Largest force error against a strict settled reference (41 saved states per case): 0.14-0.38% at 20-34 kPa and 2.3% (median 0.4%) at 50 kPa, where the 2.5 MHz table gives 2.4-3.2% and refuses 50 kPa; linear regime 0.16% (2.5 MHz table 5.6%) and 0.09% (2.4 MHz table, exact there, 0.004%). Run time 1.0-1.5x that of the table.
